title: Handling Level of Remote Sessions by Ticket Category — TimeBank
content:
Remote level schedule of TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours: the block hours of a remote session on a ticket opened in the security concern category are figured at the block's architect ratio, the session being handled by the security architect on call; those of one on a ticket opened in the outage category, at the senior engineer ratio; those of any other remote session, at the technician ratio. The draw records that level. The category is the one the ticket was opened in, as the ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket history shows it.

| Category the ticket was opened in | Ratio | Level recorded |
|---|---|---|
| security concern | architect ratio | architect |
| outage | senior engineer ratio | senior engineer |
| degraded service, service request, user onboarding, user offboarding, how-to | technician ratio | technician |

Hypothetical case on a TimeBank 20-Hour Block (architect ratio 1.75, senior engineer ratio 1.25) for 60 minutes drawn in business hours: 1.75 hours for a security concern ticket, 1.25 hours for an outage ticket, 1.00 hour for a how-to ticket.
